supersession_reason: V1's raw cross-cell-type support-rate contrast did not fully separate contact-specific alignment from cell-type differences in ATAC peak opportunity/burden. This was identified before any P1S outcome was computed. V2 makes the primary comparison a difference-in-differences: observed-minus-geometry-null support within each ATAC track, then microglia excess support versus comparator excess support.

analysis_population.contacts: C3-admissible, source-oriented Nott microglia PROMOTER_DISTAL contacts only.
analysis_population.paired_structure: Every retained contact pair and its single deterministic geometry-null interval are evaluated against all three authenticated ATAC tracks.

binary_accessibility_support.rule: A distal interval is supported in a cell-type ATAC track if it overlaps >=1 bp of >=1 authenticated ATAC peak.
binary_accessibility_support.multiplicity: Binary per interval; multiple overlapping peaks do not add weight.

construction: Work in the C3-admissible hg38 coordinate space.
Let d be the signed midpoint displacement from promoter midpoint to observed distal midpoint.
Construct the null distal interval with the same interval length at signed displacement -d from the same promoter midpoint.
Require the null interval to remain fully within the same chromosome.
If invalid at a chromosome boundary, classify NULL_NOT_CONSTRUCTIBLE; do not change distance or choose a substitute interval.
preserved_exactly: one null opportunity per constructible observed edge
promoter contact degree among constructible edges

uncertainty.method: nonparametric cluster bootstrap over promoters, resampling promoters with replacement and carrying all of each selected promoter's edges
uncertainty.why: Contacts sharing a promoter are not independent; pair-level bootstrap would be anti-conservative.

primary_requirements.R1_microglia_contact_alignment_above_own: Lower 95% promoter-cluster-bootstrap bound of mean E_microglia must be > 0.
primary_requirements.R2_microglia_excess_alignment_above_neur: Lower 95% bound of mean D_MN must be > 0.
primary_requirements.R3_microglia_excess_alignment_above_olig: Lower 95% bound of mean D_MO must be > 0.

mandatory_reporting: for each cell type: observed support rate, null support rate, mean excess support E_c
for microglia-neuron and microglia-oligo: mean difference-in-differences and 95% promoter-cluster-bootstrap interval
microglia-only, comparator-only, both-supported and neither-supported observed-pair counts
same four-way counts for null intervals
results by predeclared quartiles of post-C3 log distance and promoter degree as descriptive sensitivity only

coverage_and_local_density_sensitivity.purpose: Expose residual dependence on genomic accessibility opportunity not eliminated by the within-track null.
coverage_and_local_density_sensitivity.local_density_definition: For each observed/null distal interval and each ATAC track, count peak midpoints within +/-50 kb of the interval midpoint.
coverage_and_local_density_sensitivity.report: Report E_c and D contrasts by pooled quartiles of local peak density. Do not trim or reweight the primary population based on these results.
coverage_and_local_density_sensitivity.no_rescue: A primary fail may not be rescued by a favorable density stratum.

hard_stops: If any R1/R2/R3 lower bound <= 0: NOT_MICROGLIA_FIT_FOR_TARGET_CONSTRUCTION under P1S.
Do not substitute raw support-rate superiority for the difference-in-differences gate.
Do not import the NIH-CARD continuous-adjustment estimator.
Do not change the null after seeing cell-type support.
claim_scope: A P1S pass establishes internal microglial substrate compatibility of the Nott-centered contact object relative to same-study neuronal/oligodendrocyte ATAC and the frozen geometry null. It is not independent external corroboration, donor-independent replication, multi-source contact replication, or causal enhancer-gene assignment.
